The Use Tax Act data center companion is 2024 PA 181 (SB 237), archived at https://web.archive.org/web/20260315052620/https://legislature.mi.gov/documents/2023-2024/publicact/pdf/2024-PA-0181.pdf. legislature.mi.gov returns 403 to scripted requests. territorial_scope.description: Applies to enterprise data center facilities located in Michigan.

evidence.quote: The facility is located in this state.

summary.short: Exempts sales and use of data center equipment to qualified and enterprise data centers in Michigan from 2016 through 2050 (2065 for some sites), subject to job, investment, energy, water and certification conditions; amends 1933 PA 167 and 1937 PA 94.
summary.long: Public Acts 207 and 208 of 2024 amend the tax exemptions for data center equipment (1933 PA 167, Sec. 4ee; 1937 PA 94, Sec. 4cc). Qualified data center exemptions run from January 1, 2016 through December 31, 2050, continuing after 2022 and 2026 only if certified job counts of 400 and 1,000 are met. Enterprise data center exemptions, granted by Michigan strategic fund certificate, run to 2050 or 2065 for certain brownfield or former power-plant sites. Certificate criteria include at least $250,000,000 capital investment, 30 qualified new jobs at 150% or more of the prosperity region median wage, municipal water, green building certification, and clean energy procurement equal to 90% of forecasted electricity use. Electric rate limits, a bar on property tax benefits absent local approval, annual reporting, revocation with repayment, and a December 31, 2029 cutoff for new certificates also apply. Act 207 takes effect April 17, 2025.

notes: Registry title cites Public Acts 207 and 208 of 2024 (HB 4906/4907), but the document contains Act No. 207 (Enrolled House Bill 4906, amending 1933 PA 167 section 4ee, approved January 17, 2025, effective April 17, 2025) and Act No. 181 (Enrolled Senate Bill 237, amending 1937 PA 94 section 4cc, approved December 30, 2024, effective 'Sine Die'). No Act 208 appears. Both amended sections are restated in full and changes are not marked, so new versus unchanged text cannot be identified from the document. The two versions differ: Act 207 exempts sales of data center equipment (sales tax), Act 181 exempts storage, use or consumption (use tax); Act 181 subsection (7) and (10)(i) say 'purchase price' and 'the entity' where Act 207 says 'sales price' and 'that entity'. The text refers to 'the department' without naming it. Both enacting sections take effect 90 days after enactment. Relations and entities sections contain entries; their section_status values are required placeholders, not a claim of absence.

enforcement.max_penalty_text: Revocation within 10 years of issuance: payment of the entire amount of tax exemptions stemming from the certificate received by all persons, plus interest. Revocation after 10 years: same amount, unless the Michigan strategic fund sets a lesser amount under published guidelines, but not less than 50% of that amount.
